@@note: Machine-made (a Fable agent), not yet reviewed by a native speaker. Where the mStream mobile app (mstream_music, lib/l10n/app_pl.arb) or the terminal player (mstream-terminal-player, locales/pl.yml; master bdb174e of 2026-09-21 and main b89ad0a of 2026-10-10) had the same text or phrase, their Polish wording and terms were taken (both GPL-3.0, by this repository's owner); the rest was translated by the agent, and a second agent reviewed every message against the English and the apps' words. Register: informal (ty), as both apps. 'zakładka' names a tab (karta is the microSD card), 'Wyjście' the Output tab, 'Informacje' the About page. The rooms the notes give are those the texts were fitted to (42356b7); the layout fixes since gave most buttons and pills 2-4 px more and Small when their font doesn't fit, so a few of the apps' words a note set aside would fit now (docs/I18N.md, phase 3, lists them for a native review). The Auto DJ texts (October 2026, with the Auto DJ engine's UI) were made the same way: the mobile app's Auto DJ words (Auto DJ, Kotwica, Podążaj za klimatem, Próg podobieństwa, '{0}% lub bliżej', Ciągłość BPM, Miksowanie harmoniczne, 'od tego miejsca'; its 'Trzymaj się utworu startowego' is too wide for the Output row's line, so the Anchor's value says 'Przy utworze startowym') and a Fable agent's translation for the rest, fitted with the same checker; not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
